rows.included: Declared content-nonce and salt formats, assigned carriage custody, and public commitment consistency.
rows.name: subsec:deployment:concealment-entropy
rows.reason: The public opening can be checked, but its entropy source and private handling cannot be reconstructed. The adopted handshake’s generation and custody rules apply by value owner and layer; public format checks do not attest entropy or erasure. The handshake undertaking is held for implementation; no courtesy-standard conformance is claimed.

rows.excluded: Actual entropy generation, private custody and deletion or secrecy of undisclosed material.

rows.name: case:deployment:concealment-entropy-operator-generated
rows.reason: The operator custody assignment and salt format are public; the unpredictability and actual handling of its private salt are not. The adopter assigns the host’s blinding-value generation obligation; public declarations are checkable and actual quality/custody remain excluded. The handshake undertaking is held for implementation; no courtesy-standard conformance is claimed.

rows.excluded: Actual entropy generation, private custody and deletion or secrecy of undisclosed material.
rows.included: Declared content-nonce and salt formats, assigned carriage custody, and public commitment consistency.
rows.name: case:deployment:concealment-entropy-client-generated
rows.reason: The client source requirement is a published preclusion premise, not a checked entropy property. Append checks cover only a supplied pair; otherwise the accepting carrier owns checkable form and reuse duties. The adopter assigns author-generated blinding values and their declared custody rules; received-format checks do not establish private entropy. The handshake undertaking is held for implementation; no courtesy-standard conformance is claimed.

rows.name: case:deployment:concealment-entropy-secret-derived
rows.reason: Derivation from a client secret is an alternative mechanism; the stated phase and Actor nonce duties do not select this derivation. A published secret-derived form is a permitted alternative, not an admitted recipe or proof of quality. The handshake undertaking is held for implementation; no courtesy-standard conformance is claimed.

rows.excluded: Actual entropy generation, private custody and deletion or secrecy of undisclosed material.
rows.included: Declared content-nonce and salt formats, assigned carriage custody, and public commitment consistency.
rows.name: case:deployment:concealment-entropy-unassigned-custody
rows.reason: An absent published custody assignment is detectable, but the publication of an assignment does not establish actual private custody. The adopted standard’s custody declaration is required; a complete public assignment is checkable but actual conduct is not. The handshake undertaking is held for implementation; no courtesy-standard conformance is claimed.
